title: Health Regen - Configurable
author: oOCamilleOo
summary: Configurable health regeneration for humans and vampires. Stops adding healing at full recoverable health or the current vampire segment limit, with optional combat and lost-segment recovery.

file.description: Fixed an issue that could prevent vampire segment recovery from working for some players.
